tasks.label: build and run current project
tasks.command: d="${fileDirname}"; while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do p=$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.csproj' | head -n1); [ -n "$p" ] && break; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -n "$p" ] || { echo 'error: no .csproj found'; exit 1; }; echo "Project: $p"; dotnet build "$p" -nologo -clp:"NoSummary;ForceNoAlign" && dotnet run --project "$p" --no-build
